body: Disposable test character confirmed the full right-click->attack pipeline works correctly (real damage exchange both ways). TestWarrior separately found repeatedly dying within seconds of revival with zero combat text across 3 polling passes -- King Worm NM (800HP/60dmg, live in this Meadow instance) is the strong suspect but exact mechanism not caught; commit 634b9eb
title: Right-click attack verified working; unresolved silent-death bug flagged on Meadow test character
